component.name: PULS DiskInfo
component.summary: Disk health and S.M.A.R.T. monitoring for Linux

description.p: PULS DiskInfo is a professional-grade disk health monitoring application for Linux, inspired by CrystalDiskInfo. It reads S.M.A.R.T. data from your drives and presents it in a clear, detailed interface.

ul.li: Health status monitoring (Good/Caution/Bad) with color-coded indicators
Real-time temperature monitoring with visual gauges
Complete S.M.A.R.T. attributes table with threshold warnings
Support for HDD, SATA SSD, NVMe SSD, USB, and SSHD drives
Automatic drive detection and USB hotplug support
Drive identity details (model, serial, firmware, interface, capacity)
Power-on hours, cycle count, and total data written/read statistics
Periodic auto-refresh of disk health data
Non-destructive surface testing and sector latency benchmarks

screenshot.caption: Main storage health and temperature overview
Temperature history and dynamic telemetry graphing

description.p: Modernized build system, modular test suites, headless CLI reporting, mock storage simulation, structured logging, and enhanced S.M.A.R.T. diagnostic accuracy.

Feature expansion release inspired by Hard Disk Sentinel. Adds health score %, temperature history graph, live I/O rate labels, non-destructive surface scan with heatmap, alert system, enhanced export (HTML/JSON/file), S.M.A.R.T. trend indicators, seek latency benchmark, expanded drive details, and partition usage progress bars.
Telemetry additions and LVM/LUKS mapping fixes, including safer benchmarking checks and GTK CSS hover fixes.
